description:
# 0.485.0

Enable Pro for ginlemon.iconpackstudio v2.5 build 003 (auto-generated).

patches.name: Enable Pro
patches.description: Auto-generated: unlocks Blurwallpaper Pro.

patches.name: Remove Ads
patches.description: Auto-generated: unlocks Air Horn Premium (ads off, purchase owned).

patches.name: Enable Premium
patches.description: Auto-generated: unlocks Bend Premium.

patches.name: Disable Ads
patches.description: Disables Duolingo ads by forcing AdsConfig.b() to false.

patches.name: Enable Max
patches.description: Unlocks Duolingo Max: Max badge, subscription gates and immersive (Max) subscription.

patches.name: Enable Video Calling
patches.description: Enables Duolingo video call (Max) features.

patches.name: Unlimited Energy
patches.description: Sets energy current to max by mirroring max into current.

patches.name: Unlimited Timers
patches.description: Sets timer boost durations and free-boost flags to Integer.MAX_VALUE / true.

patches.name: Zero Gem Cost
patches.description: Sets every shop item gem price to 0.

patches.name: Enable Premium
patches.description: Enables app features locked behind the subscription paywall (template demo).

patches.name: Enable Pro
patches.description: Auto-generated: unlocks Investing Pro.

patches.name: Fix: Fair Value
patches.description: Recomputes the masked Fair Value as price * (1 + upside) from the parsed fields.

patches.name: Fix: Financial Health parse
patches.description: Pre-seeds the scorecard's numeric fields with a boxed 0.0 so a response missing `minScore`/`score`/`maxScore` parses instead of throwing `Missing field in Scorecard` and blanking Financial Health and the Health tab.

patches.name: Fix: Options intrinsic parse
patches.description: The options chain response omits `intrinsic` on every row, so the generated adapter throws `Required value 'intrinsic' missing` and the Options tab dies with "Update failed". Seeds the field with a boxed 0.0 and routes the missing-value branch past the throw, so the chain renders.

patches.name: Fix: cash-flow rating enum crash
patches.description: Bakes the cash-flow rating enum's FAIR constant name, so Moshi's reflective enum adapter no longer throws Missing field when View More in Most Undervalued opens.

patches.name: Fix: chart font-cache crash
patches.description: Bakes the chart Typeface cache's locale fields so the cache is built instead of NPE-ing on a null list when a chart scrolls into view or Financial Data opens.

patches.name: Hide: See All Pro Data CTA
patches.description: Collapses the orange "See All Pro Data" promo WebView so the banner no longer renders.

patches.name: PairIP manifest bypass
patches.description: Replaces the PairIP Application class with com.fusionmedia.investing.InvestingApplication, drops LicenseActivity and CHECK_LICENSE.

patches.name: Remove: Subscription is Active screen
patches.description: Removes the Subscription is Active screen shown at startup and enters the app directly.

patches.name: Unlock: Fair Value
patches.description: Forces the server `locked` flag off on every Fair Value datum (overview cell, Fair Value page, Popular/Ideas columns, analyst target and consensus) so the values render.

patches.name: Unlock: Ideas data
patches.description: Forces the server `locked` flag off on Idea rows and their Growth/Profit/Cash-Flow ratings, so the Most Undervalued list and idea details show data instead of locks.

patches.name: Unlock: Key Statistics
patches.description: Forces the server `isLocked` flag off on every Key Statistics metric (`KeyStatisticsResponse$Metric.d`), so the orange `Unlock` pill next to the Pro rows (Fair Value, analyst targets) is not drawn.

patches.name: Unlock: Pro Tips
patches.description: Forces the server `locked` flag off on Pro Tips, so the tip text renders instead of the lock.

patches.name: Unlock: Pro Tips CTA
patches.description: Blanks the `Unlock All N Tips` CTA label the Pro Tips section builds from the `unlock_all_tips` localized string, so the orange upgrade button no longer sits under the tips.

patches.name: Bypass Play install check
patches.description: Reports the installer as com.android.vending so the sideload block on onboarding never trips.

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Stops the Google Ads and AppLovin MAX banner, interstitial, native and rewarded load calls so no ad requests fill.

patches.name: Unlock Insider (bundle)
patches.description: Forces Insider state inside the Hermes bundle: user.is_supporter + the Insider-only 0.1 rating scale toggle.

patches.name: Unlock Insider Entitlements
patches.description: Makes Insider active: RevenueCat entitlements are reported active and the JS supporter flag is forced true.

options.description: Fake a live RevenueCat insider entitlement so Insider gates and paywalls open.
Report the installer as com.android.vending so the sideload block never trips.
No-op the banner and interstitial load calls so no ads fill.

patches.name: Enable Premium
patches.description: Auto-generated: unlocks Sleep Premium.

patches.name: Enable Pro
patches.description: Auto-generated: unlocks Smart Launcher Pro (all premium features, upsell banners gone).

patches.name: Force Pro License State
patches.description: Auto-generated: keeps the reactive/snapshot license status permanently Pro (no trial countdown, restore prompts or promo flow).

patches.name: Force Skip Onboarding
patches.description: Skips Smart Launcher's first-run onboarding wizard (WizardComplete gate).

patches.name: Play Billing Always OK
patches.description: Forces every Google Play Billing response code to OK(0): connect, query and purchase results all report success.

patches.name: Remove Ads and Promotions
patches.description: Removes Smart Launcher's upsell surfaces: Get Pro banner, periodic/seasonal promos and sponsored search row.

patches.name: Remove Genuine APK Check
patches.description: Smart Launcher refuses to run a build whose signing certificate is not the official store key and exits silently at launch (`SLTool: Not genuine apk`). Patched builds are always re-signed, so this disables that self-integrity gate.

patches.name: Enable Pro
patches.description: Unlocks Icon Pack Studio Pro (all premium features). Use this instead of De-Vanced's 'Unlock pro' for 2.5 build 003: that patch only matches the pre-obfuscation IPSPurchaseRepository class.

patches.name: Play Billing Always OK
patches.description: Forces every Google Play Billing response code to OK(0): connect, query and purchase results all report success.

patches.name: Remove Ads and Promotions
patches.description: Removes Icon Pack Studio's upsell surfaces (GET PRO button, locked badges) and stops the aggressive-mode onboarding paywall.

repoDescription: Morphe patch bundle endpoint + CHANGELOG (mirror of the Codeberg release host)
